name: voice.elevenlabs-voices
title: Voices (ElevenLabs)
summary: The ElevenLabs provider of voice.list: the voices the key can use, or a catalogue of premade voices when the key may not list them. Needs the elevenlabs_api_key secret file and network access.
description: Returns ElevenLabs voices with their ids, names and labels, so an agent can pick the voice for voice.speak (provider elevenlabs). A key scoped to text-to-speech gets 401 from the voices API: the tool then returns the built-in catalogue of premade voices (source "catalog") with a warning. Reads the elevenlabs_api_key secret file; the key is never logged or returned. Retries 429, 5xx and network errors.

search.description: Keep only voices whose id, name or labels contain this text (case-insensitive); omit to list all.

id.description: Voice id to pass as voice to voice.speak.

voice_id.description: The same id under ElevenLabs' own name.

labels.description: Voice labels such as gender, age, accent or use case.

source.description: api: listed by ElevenLabs for this key; catalog: the built-in premade list (the key may not list).
